page.content:
Arthur's nephew, sun-strength knight of Orkney.

How Gawain connects

  • Faction: Round Table — Gawain is Arthur's nephew among the Table.
  • Character: Lancelot — Gawain becomes Lancelot's enemy after the deaths at Guinevere's rescue.

What is Gawain?

Gawain is the early romances' first hero — courteous, solar, and later the bitter foe of Lancelot after Gareth's death. The Green Knight tale is his most famous English test.

Key threads lead to Round Table and Lancelot.
